environment.build: cargo test dev Rust profile; bundled native build

protocol.metric: wall time around Rewriter::rewrite, including two sequential passes and fidelity; excludes model load, ASR, capture, queue, storage and UI
protocol.warmup: one uncached reference, three cached rewrites; resident weights throughout
protocol.equivalence: all 60 outputs exactly matched successful uncached reference with README.txt retained
limitations: One synthetic English fixture; not a held-out corpus or user-visible latency benchmark
No upstream CLI comparison, independent cold starts, power draw or sustained thermal study
Other CPUs, GPUs, precisions, personalized prompts and custom GGUF unqualified
P90 descriptive for this run; no p99 or universal SOTA claim
